description: This file contains the DataLabelMapper class responsible for mapping DataLabel objects between the DocumentObjectModel and rendering models within the MigraDoc project. It handles properties related to styling, formatting, position, and type of data labels used in charts.

classes.name: DataLabelMapper
classes.description: A mapper class responsible for translating DataLabel properties between different representations within the MigraDoc chart rendering process.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Charts.DataLabel object to a DataLabel object.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates an instance of DataLabelMapper and maps properties from a DOM data label to a rendering DataLabel.
